scenes.script_excerpt:
The room is almost devoid of furniture. There is a fold-up table and chair with a phone, a modern, and a powerbook computer. The only light in the room is the glow of the computer.

Sitting there, her hands still on the keyboard, is TRINITY; a woman in black leather.

BIG COP
Get your hands behind your head!

Trinity rises.

BIG COP
Hands behind your head! Now! Do it!

She slowly puts her hands behind her head.

visual_beats: Trinity jumps from one roof to the next.
Agent Brown duplicates the move exactly.
Trinity jumps onto a moving train.
Agent Brown hurls through the air barely reaching the last car.
Trinity hurtles into the empty night space, diving through a window.
Agent Brown touches his earpiece as the train slides him past the window.
audio_beats: Metal scream of an El train.
transition_hooks: Cut to street with telephone booth.
Cut to Agent Smith in alley below.

prompt_blueprint.video_prompt_seed: Extended rooftop chase, Trinity performs acrobatic leaps, agent duplicates moves, dramatic camera angles

scenes.script_excerpt:
On the roof, Trinity is running as Agent Brown rises over the parapet, leading the cops in pursuit.

Trinity begins to jump from one roof to the next, her moverents so clean, gliding in and out of each jump, contrasted to the wild jumps of the cops.

Agent Brown, however, has the same unnatural grace.

The METAL SCREAM of an EL TRAIN is heard and Trinity turns to it, racing for the back of the building.

The edge falls away into a wide back alley.

signature_dialogue: You take the blue pill and the story ends. You wake in your bed and you believe whatever you want to believe.
You take the red pill and you stay in Wonderland and I show you how deep the rabbit-hole goes.
visual_beats: Dark figure stares out the windows.
Morpheus strides to Neo.
Morpheus drops a red pill into Neo's right hand and a blue pill in his left.
The pills are reflected in Morpheus' glasses.
Neo swallows the red pill.
audio_beats: Sound of wind battering a loose pane of glass.
transition_hooks: Cut to Neo waking up in a high-tech lab.
Cut to loading program with Trinity, Apoc, Cypher.

scenes.script_excerpt:
Unfortunately, no one can be told what the Matrix is. You have to see it for yourself.

NEO
How?

MORPHEUS
Hold out your hands.

In Neo's right hand, Morpheus drops a red pill.

MORPHEUS
This is your last chance. After this, there is no going back.

signature_dialogue: This is the Chicago you know. Chicago as it was at the end of the twentieth century. This Chicago exists only as part of a neural-interactive simulation that we call the Matrix.
visual_beats: Neo and Morpheus stand in a blank-white space.
The chairs from the hotel set up in front of a large-screen television.
Images of Chicago in 1996 flash on the television.
The television changes to show a scorched and split earth.
Neo and Morpheus in the chairs, now sitting in the middle of the black desert.
Sentinels are seen.
Humans in gelatin cocoons.
Human fetus growing around a brain-jack.
audio_beats: Explosions lighting up a bloody battle field.
Sound of the plant like the sound of the ocean heard from inside the belly of Leviathan.
transition_hooks: Cut to Neo waking up from a violent dream.

scenes.script_excerpt:
This is the Construct.

Startled, Neo whips around and finds Morpheus now in the room with him.

MORPHEUS
It is our loading program. We can load anything from clothes, to weapons, to training simulations. Anything we need.

Morpheus walks past Neo and when Neo turns he sees the two leather chairs from the hotel set up in front of a large-screen television.

MORPHEUS
Sit down.

signature_dialogue: This is incredible. I know Kung Fu.
visual_beats: Neo is plugged in, hanging in one of the suspension chairs.
Tank is flipping through a tall carousel loaded with micro discs.
Neo's body jumps against the harness as his eyes clamp shut.
Monitors kick wildly as his heart pounds, adrenaline surges, and his brain sizzles.
Neo's eyes snap open.
audio_beats: Clicking and whirring of computer equipment.
Sound of adrenaline surging and brain sizzles.

scenes.script_excerpt:
TANK
We're supposed to load all these operations programs first, but this is some major boring shit. Why don't we start something a little fun?

Tank smiles as he plops into his operator's chair. He begins flipping through a tall carousel loaded with micro discs.

TANK
How about sore combat training?

Neo reads the label on the disk.

NEO
Jiujitsu? I'm going to learn jujitsu?
